🚨 Pedri's words to DSports on Lionel Messi, Argentina and El Clásico:

🔹 “Argentina has a special place in my heart because of Leo Messi. I’ve supported him since I was a child, and whenever Spain were eliminated from tournaments, I would always support Argentina because of the love I’ve had for Leo for years.”

🔹 “In Argentina, I support Newells Old Boys because of Messi.”

🔹 “My hair dye was the result of a promise I made before winning the World Cup. It has grown a little now, but when the time comes to get rid of it, I will.”

🔹 “For me, Messi is the greatest player in history. I know some people have different opinions, but based on what I’ve seen myself, no one comes close to him. I was lucky enough to play alongside him for a whole year, but that year felt far too short. I wish I could have spent many more years with him.”

🔹 “Clásico? For me, it’s like any other match, even though I fully understand how important it is for us. I stick to my usual routine and don’t do anything special just because we’re facing Real Madrid.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Fermín López' words to RTVE ahead of El Clásico:

🔹 “Real Madrid’s constant references to the Negreira case are getting a bit TIRING because we’re showing our quality on the pitch. It’s unfair to engage in this kind of rhetoric when things are going well for us. If they keep pushing this narrative, it’s because it suits them, but we don’t get involved in it.”

🔹 “Who would I rather see missing from Real Madrid, Courtois or Mbappé? I’d choose both. Courtois earns his team a lot of points with his incredible saves, while Mbappé makes the difference and scores plenty of goals.”

🔹 “There’s no favourite in El Clásico. It doesn’t matter what form either team is in; either side can win. We’re two big clubs, and we must focus on playing our football, controlling our emotions and paying attention to the small details.”

🔹 “My favourite for the Ballon d’Or? Lamine Yamal.”

↪Asked why: “Because Lamine is the BEST”. #fcblive

🚨 Joan García's words to @beteve ahead of El Clásico:

🔹 “We wanted to win in Paris, but we knew it would be a difficult match. Playing every three or four days means you have to shift your focus quickly. We competed well against a fantastic team that reached the Champions League final in the last two seasons. There were positives, but also things we need to analyse and improve. Overall, I think the match helped us more than it hurt us ahead of El Clásico.”

🔹 “It would be a mistake to think that winning El Clásico could guarantee us the LEAGUE TITLE. Titles aren’t decided in October. We respect our opponents, but we’re very excited to put in a great performance and win El Clásico at home.”

🔹 “Is Courtois the best GK in the world? Obviously. Courtois has proven over many years that he’s one of the best goalkeepers in the world.”

🔹 “Can Barcelona win every trophy? Yes, absolutely. We have a fantastic squad and have shown that we can compete with everyone and for every title.”

🔹 “The Champions League should be one of our objectives, but the same applies to La Liga and the Copa del Rey. We have a squad capable of competing in all three competitions, so we must believe we can win everything and work hard to achieve it.”

🔹 “How do you describe Szczęsny? Szczęsny is a special character. He has moments when he jokes and makes everyone laugh, but he also knows when to be serious. When it’s time to work hard in training, he does so. It’s no coincidence that he’s spent so many years at the highest level.”

🔹 “Your move from Espanyol to Barça, how did you make the decision? It was a very important decision in my career. I spoke extensively with the people closest to me, and we concluded that it was the best option for me. I made the decision without any doubts. I haven’t lost any friendships because of the move. You have to separate personal relationships from professional life. I haven’t had any problems in that regard, and I’m very happy about it.”

🔹 “Fans chanting ‘Joan García from La Masia’ at Spotify Camp Noy? This chant is funny (laughs). My teammates too joke with me about it in the dressing room. I take it in good spirits and with a sense of humour.” #fcblive

🚨 | Hansi Flick's pre-match conference ahead of El Clasico:

I have good feelings, they've all recovered well for the match." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Flick: "The refereeing? It won't affect it. I trust the refereeing. We see quality refereeing, and each of us has to protect our own." #fcblive ✅

🚨🎙️| Flick: "Did the defeat in Paris help us? Of course it did. We've spoken with the players. There are aspects of our game that we have to improve, we have to grow. Tomorrow we play against one of the best in the world, and it's an opportunity to grow." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Flick: "Koundé won't be available tomorrow, we don't want to risk him, we have to accept it. Olmo was in good form, he was at 100%. He's been unlucky. We have to accept it. He's going to miss a lot of games and this situation isn't easy for him. We also have Fermín." #fcblive ❌
🚨🎙️| Flick: "Conceding set piece goals? It's a strength of Real Madrid, of the best teams. We talked about it today and prepared for it. We have to defend better than we did in Paris." #fcblive
